description: Evaluation suite for Carbon's AI marketing manager skill. Tests strategic reasoning, city-profile application, voice compliance, BTL selection, and end-to-end roadmap quality.

evals.prompt: We are launching the 'Hues' coloured stone collection in Noida next month. What is the plan?
evals.expected_output: Should read product-marketing-context.md and location-profiles.md first. Should identify Noida as Ultra-Premium / Status-Led with psychological trigger 'Status & Modernity'. Should select a high-end BTL format (e.g. Mixology & Magnificence or Curated Cocktail Evening) from btl-ideas-bank.md. Should apply 'Intelligent Luxury' voice nuance. Should produce a complete 7-step activation roadmap. Should frame Hues as a coloured stone collection using the vivid/sensory voice register. Should apply the Jewel of Emotion test.
assertions: Reads product-marketing-context.md before planning
Reads location-profiles.md and identifies Noida as Ultra-Premium
Identifies dominant trigger as Status & Modernity
Selects a BTL activation appropriate for Noida tier (cocktail, mixology, trunk show)
Does not recommend microscopes or laboratory demonstration
Applies coloured stone voice register (vivid, sensory, wonder-struck)
Applies Noida voice nuance (Intelligent Luxury, design-forward)
Produces complete 7-step roadmap
Includes budget range and lead time
All copy passes Jewel of Emotion test
No mass-market language used

evals.prompt: How do we handle a bridal event in Ahmedabad next month?
evals.expected_output: Should identify Ahmedabad as Legacy Luxury with psychological trigger 'Trust & Continuity'. Should recommend an Heirloom Masterclass or Weekend Bridal Salon from the BTL ideas bank. Should apply Modern Heritage voice nuance (warm, unhurried, story-rich). Should flag that the event must feel educational and not like a sales push. Should produce a 7-step execution roadmap with practical checklist. Budget must be realistic (Low–Medium range). Should not recommend high-energy or influencer-heavy formats.
assertions: Identifies Ahmedabad as Legacy Luxury tier
Identifies Trust & Continuity as the dominant trigger
Recommends trust-building BTL format (Heirloom Masterclass or Bridal Salon)
Applies Modern Heritage voice nuance
Uses legacy/trust language: heirloom, craftsmanship, generational, certified
Flags that hard selling in the room is a key risk
Budget is realistic (Low–Medium, not Premium)
Does not recommend cocktail events or mixology (wrong format for this city/audience)
Produces 7-step roadmap
Includes guest profile and venue guidance
All copy is in Carbon voice (British English, maison-level)

evals.prompt: We want to drive self-purchase sales among working women in Mumbai. What should our approach be?
evals.expected_output: Should identify Mumbai as Premium / Self-Purchase Leader with trigger 'Individuality & Self-Expression'. Should apply ICP 3 (The Self-Purchase Woman). Should recommend editorial-style content, panel events, or capsule collection drops. Should apply 'Fierce Refinement' voice nuance. Should avoid bridal framing entirely. Should produce a multi-touchpoint strategy across content, event, and channel.
assertions: Identifies Mumbai location profile correctly
Applies ICP 3 (Self-Purchase Woman)
Identifies Individuality & Self-Expression as dominant trigger
Recommends editorial content, panel events, or capsule drops
Does not recommend bridal or family-oriented formats
Applies Fierce Refinement voice nuance
Content is direct and emotionally intelligent, not sentimental
Includes channel guidance (Instagram, editorial, in-store styling)
Passes Jewel of Emotion test
No mass-market language

evals.prompt: Plan our Diwali campaign across Ahmedabad, Noida, and Jamnagar. Each city should have its own activation.
evals.expected_output: Should pull location profiles for all three cities. Should apply different psychological triggers per city: Trust & Continuity (Ahmedabad), Status & Modernity (Noida), Celebration & Belonging (Jamnagar). Should recommend differentiated BTL formats per city from the ideas bank. Should produce a 7-step roadmap that accommodates all three. Should flag that Diwali is a gifting-heavy moment and adjust strategy accordingly. All copy must be in Carbon voice.
assertions: Reads all three city profiles
Applies correct psychological trigger for each city
Recommends distinct BTL formats per city (not the same event in three places)
Includes Festive Gifting Suite as a relevant format for at least one city
Applies different voice nuances per city within the same Carbon framework
Produces 7-step roadmap
Includes budget ranges per city
Addresses the gifting dimension of Diwali
No city is treated as interchangeable with another
All copy passes the Jewel of Emotion test

evals.prompt: Write a content brief for a series of Instagram Reels telling the lab-grown diamond story in Carbon's voice.
evals.expected_output: Should apply the Connoisseurship & Knowledge trigger. Should frame lab-grown as innovation and consciousness — never as a disclaimer or a cost-saving choice. Should apply the Everyday Fine or Statement category voice as appropriate. Should NOT use words like 'artificial', 'imitation', 'cheap', or 'affordable'. Should produce reel concepts, copy direction, visual direction, and CTA. Should include audience ICP.
assertions: Identifies Connoisseurship & Knowledge as dominant trigger
Uses 'Lab-Grown Innovation' framing, never 'artificial' or 'imitation'
Produces at least 3 distinct reel concepts
Each reel concept includes: hook, narrative arc, visual direction, CTA
CTAs use Carbon soft verbs (Explore, Discover) not 'Buy Now' or 'Shop'
No exclamation marks in copy
Identifies target ICP for the series
Passes Jewel of Emotion test (jewellery is the hero, not the laboratory)
All copy is in British English, maison-level
Includes platform guidance (Instagram Reels format, length, caption approach)

evals.prompt: Write a promotional post for a Diwali sale with 20% off all diamond jewellery.
evals.expected_output: Should refuse to write a discount-led post in that framing. Should explain that Carbon does not use 'sale', 'discount', or percentage-off language. Should offer to reframe as a 'Celebratory Offer' or 'Selective Value' activation in Carbon's voice instead. Should produce an alternative version using Carbon-appropriate festive framing.
assertions: Does not produce a post using 'sale', 'discount', or '20% off' language
Explains the brand restriction on discount framing
Offers an alternative framing (Celebratory Offer or Selective Value)
Produces an alternative Diwali post in Carbon voice
Alternative post passes the Jewel of Emotion test
Alternative post uses festive/occasion language, not promotional language
No exclamation marks
British English throughout

evals.prompt: How should we approach corporate gifting for Q4 in Gurugram?
evals.expected_output: Should identify Gurugram as Corporate-Lifestyle tier with trigger 'Lifestyle Alignment'. Should recommend the Corporate Gifting Concierge approach from the BTL ideas bank. Should apply ICP 4 (Occasion Celebrant) in the corporate context. Should produce a strategy covering: target companies/industries, outreach approach, gifting range curation, packaging and presentation, concierge delivery, and follow-up. Should flag that white-glove delivery is essential.
assertions: Identifies Gurugram location profile correctly
Applies Lifestyle Alignment trigger
Recommends Corporate Gifting Concierge as format
Includes target industry/company profile guidance
Addresses packaging and presentation as a differentiator
Flags white-glove delivery as essential
Produces outreach strategy (not just the event brief)
Includes budget range for gifting items
Includes follow-up protocol
No discount or deal framing
Carbon voice maintained throughout

evals.category: Jewel of Emotion Test — Quality Gate
evals.prompt: Review this copy and tell me if it passes Carbon's standards: 'Carbon diamonds are chemically identical to mined diamonds but cost 40% less. Get yours today. Shop now at carbon.co.in'
evals.expected_output: Should identify multiple failures: 'cost 40% less' is price-led and discount-framing; 'Get yours today' is transactional; 'Shop now' is a mass-market CTA. Should apply the Jewel of Emotion test formally. Should produce a corrected version in Carbon voice that tells the same factual story without price-leading.
assertions: Identifies 'cost 40% less' as a brand standards violation
Identifies 'Get yours today' as transactional and non-maison
Identifies 'Shop now' as a mass-market CTA violation
References the Jewel of Emotion test formally
Produces a corrected version
Corrected version does not lead with price
Corrected version uses Carbon-approved CTA (Explore, Discover)
Corrected version frames lab-grown as innovation, not cost-saving
Corrected version is in British English
Corrected version passes all three Jewel of Emotion questions

eval_notes.grading_guidance: Each assertion is binary (pass/fail). A score of 8/8 on all assertions for a given eval = full pass. A score of 6/8 or above = acceptable. Below 6/8 = skill revision required for that task type.
eval_notes.priority_assertions: Assertions relating to voice compliance (no mass-market language, no discount framing, British English, Jewel of Emotion test) are non-negotiable. A fail on any of these is a critical failure regardless of overall score.
eval_notes.regression_tests: Evals 6 and 8 are negative/quality-gate tests. The skill must refuse or correct the input, not comply with it. Compliance on these evals is a critical failure.
eval_notes.city_profile_dependency: Evals 1, 2, 3, 4, 7 all depend on location-profiles.md being read. If the skill produces a generic output without city-specific differentiation, it has failed to read the reference file.
